description: R002A J5(b) declared divergence records (issue 91 section 4.1, docs/state-contracts/R002A.md). A record admits a difference between an installer blob at the README review-first pinned commit (INSTALL_COMMIT / $InstallCommit) and the checked-out installer. Required fields: pinnedCommit, path, pinnedBlob, currentBlob, reason, owner (work order), date, trigger (normally 'README re-pinned'). A record whose commit or blob IDs no longer match, or that covers no remaining difference, is stale and turns J5 red. Never used for the docs-receipt pins (J5(a)), which have no divergence path.
